extra.reason: Scaffold committed in this session

Decision: build a custom incremental engine (crate fjfj-engine). Rationale: DICE is not published and tracks Buck2's needs; salsa's single-revision IDE model does not fit thousands of concurrent actions with cancellation. Owning the engine gives control over parallelism, cancellation, Bazel cycle/error semantics, and persistence. Decided by Nathan Howell 2026-09-03.
Decided: all modules in Starlark, no native modules.
Decided by Nathan Howell 2026-09-03: Bazel 9.2.0 is the base compatibility target. --incompatible_* defaults follow 9.2.0; the flag default table is generated from bazel 9.2.0 help flags-as-proto.

Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/publish.rs; exhaustive check passes for fsync-before-rename and finds the truncated-output counterexample without fsync. Lean vocabulary/invariant in spec/Fjfj/Publish.lean. Runs under bazel test //crates/fjfj-models:fjfj-models_test.

Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/scheduler.rs: diamond graph with 2 edits and 1 cancel, cyclic variant, and the mixed-version bug as a switchable flaw. Correct protocol satisfies no-reads-from-the-future, verified-implies-current-deps, quiescence-is-settlement, early cutoff reachable, cycle reported. Flawed protocol produces the counterexample. Invariants stated in spec/Fjfj/Engine.lean.

Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/daemon.rs: two clients, spawn race, daemon and client crashes, idle timeout race, stale lock. Found and encoded the rule that a daemon with blocked clients must not idle out. Negative test: unbroken stale lock wedges clients. Lean vocabulary in spec/Fjfj/Daemon.lean.

spec/Fjfj/ActionKey.lean; parity tests in fjfj-remote reproduce Bazel 9.2.0 Action/Command bytes.

Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/dynamic.rs: local/remote race, async cancel racing loser finish, failed branch does not win, atomic claim before publish. Correct protocol satisfies publish-exactly-once, cancelled-never-publishes, failure-does-not-win, quiescence with cleaned scratch; check-then-publish variant double-publishes. Lean rules in spec/Fjfj/Dynamic.lean; design rules in docs/design/sandboxing.md.

Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/compaction.rs: writes, log fsync/ack, temp snapshot, fsync, rename, truncate, crash with recovery. Invariant recoverable>=acked holds in every state for fsync-rename-truncate ordering; truncate-before-rename loses acknowledged writes. Contract in spec/Fjfj/Persistence.lean; rules in docs/design/incremental-engine.md.

Decision: escalate from Stateright to TLA+/Apalache only when (a) the explicit state space exceeds ~50M states after bounding, (b) a property needs symbolic parameters (unbounded clients/nodes/versions) to be meaningful, or (c) a fairness/liveness argument cannot be expressed as a bounded quiescence property. None of the six models built so far met any criterion; all check in under a second. Re-evaluate when fjfj-engine internals are modelled with Loom.

Stateright model in crates/fjfj-models/src/disk_cache.rs: two writers, reader, GC; temp+rename writes; AC-before-CAS GC order; verify CAS on hit. Flawed variant (trust AC) serves a missing blob. Rules in docs/design/remote-execution.md.

Decided by Nathan Howell 2026-09-03: interleave analysis and execution from day one (Skymeld). No phase barrier key in fjfj-engine; action keys depend only on their owner configured target. Lean: spec/Fjfj/Configuration.lean.

Decided by Nathan Howell 2026-09-03: ConfiguredTargetKey includes the configuration hash and nodes from all configurations stay resident (memory and disk). Option changes never discard the analysis cache. LRU eviction is a later optimisation bead, not part of key design. Lean: spec/Fjfj/Configuration.lean.

Measured on this repo's real graph (37,685 nodes, 98,239 edges) in crates/fjfj-spike-persist, -c opt, best of 5. bytes/node and cold load: columnar+zstd 29.1 / 7.9ms; rkyv raw 183.8 / 1.4ms scan (7.8ms materialised); rkyv+zstd 38.7 / 4.2ms; redb 223.6 / 25.4ms; fjall 221.5 / 143.6ms. Full table in docs/design/incremental-engine.md. rules_go/rules_python fixtures deferred to a follow-up bead: the 7x gap is encoding-driven and will not flip with graph shape.

Decided 2026-09-03: snapshot + delta log only, no KV store (all configs resident means disk is a serialization of memory). Encoding: columnar sections (interned strings, content-deduplicated delta+varint edge lists, per-node columns) in zstd frames, eager decode. Rejected rkyv (6x larger raw, 33% larger with zstd), redb/fjall (7-8x larger, slower), RocksDB (moot; not built). Budget: 30 bytes/node, 250ns/node cold load. Spike data in docs/design/incremental-engine.md; Lean in spec/Fjfj/Persistence.lean (delta-coding roundtrip proven).
